business_problem: Nationwide needed to convert thousands of pages of highly technical veterinary information and decades of pet insurance experience into understandable, preventive pet health guidance for everyday pet owners.
solution_summary: Nationwide built Pet HealthZone as a consumer-facing digital experience that uses generative artificial intelligence to convert internal and expert knowledge into accessible pet health guidance. The ingest layer described on the page is Nationwide's knowledge corpus: 40+ years of pet insurance experience across dog and cat breeds plus thousands of pages of veterinary data and information. In the processing layer, Gen AI supports Nationwide's data scientists, breed experts, and veterinarians as they draft and refine Pet HealthZone content from technical source material into plain-language explanations. Human experts remain in the loop to ensure accuracy. The resulting content is organized and delivered through Pet HealthZone, which serves pet owners breed-related risk insights, preventive measures, early-detection advice, breed characteristics, and related facts. No external AI vendor, cloud platform, or API is named, so the implementation is best characterized as an in-house, expert-reviewed GenAI content generation workflow feeding a digital self-service resource.

solution_components.name: generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI)
solution_components.role: Helps Nationwide's experts write Pet HealthZone content from technical veterinary information while supporting an accuracy-reviewed authoring workflow.

solution_components.name: Pet HealthZone
solution_components.role: Serves the final digital resource that presents breed-specific health risks, prevention guidance, and related information to pet owners.

data_flow: Nationwide draws on 40+ years of pet insurance experience and thousands of pages of veterinary information. Its data scientists, breed experts, and veterinarians use generative AI to draft and refine Pet HealthZone content, then publish that content through the digital resource so pet owners can access risk, prevention, and early-detection guidance for their pets.
business_outcome: Nationwide created a free digital resource that gives pet owners easier access to breed-related health risks, preventive measures, and early-detection guidance, while helping internal experts turn technical veterinary material into consumer-friendly content.
